items.name: Dockin and Clockin Dunkirk 2026

venue.name: [Clarion Hotel and Conference Center Dunkirk, NY](https://www.choicehotels.com/new-york/dunkirk/clarion-hotels/ny243)
venue.address: 30 Lake Shore Dr E, Dunkirk, NY 14048
venue.details: Bayfront Room, will be signs at the venue

items.information:
All competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the Competition Procedures tab.

**Due to the size of the venue we must STRICTLY enforce the 1 guest per competitor limit.**

**The venue has a no outside food or drink policy but allows small snacks and drinks for personal consumption.**

items.name: North Star Cubing Challenge MN 2026
items.information:
This is the 8th annual North Star Cubing Challenge competition in Minnesota!

This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/).
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBa2lJIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--1f97c854b41905e0a0658611c178db646a55f666/MCA-Final-Logo%20(WCA%20website%20version).png)

We have local Facebook groups for our Cubing Area. Feel free to join the [Minnesota Cubing Community](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1798123093777480) and follow the [Midwest Cubing Assocation ](https://www.facebook.com/midwestcubing)for information and announcements on upcoming competitions.
